title: No loose nuke: NEST and FBI WMD staff stayed in New Jersey with their families

tellings.quote: I can tell you it wasn't loose nukes. Um and why I know that for sure is because I know people that work on the Nest team.

plain: The 2024 sightings over New Jersey were not about a missing nuclear bomb, says Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot. He tells Michels he knows this because he knows people on NEST, the government's nuclear emergency response team, and FBI weapons-of-mass-destruction staff who stayed in New Jersey with their families, which he says they would not have done if a bomb were loose. His knowledge comes from what those people told him.
